description: Get map data: pins, clusters, or heatmaps. Billed per cluster or heatmap cell returned, or per field, per home returned for pins. Scope it with all four bbox coordinates or a polygon. With no place filter, the box or polygon may cover no more homes than one country holds. A call with neither must carry a filter on one country, such as country_abbreviation_eq=CA, or on a narrower place inside one country. A call that names no place, covers more than one country's homes, or filters on more than one country is refused with a 400, so several countries take one call each. A heatmap needs all four bbox coordinates, and a heatmap scoped by a polygon alone is refused. Modes: cluster=true, heatmap=true. There is no cap on how many properties a request may match, so set abort_over yourself if you want a request to give up past a certain number. For maps of active inventory, add has_expand_listings_eq=true to filters so listing-less parcels don't pad results.

abort_over.description: Abort if results exceed this count (cost protection)

cluster_over.description: Auto-cluster when results exceed this count

exclude.description: Source classes to leave out, comma separated, such as "inferred" or "inferred,observed". Checks the selected fields that have a source column and the heatmap field, and a heatmap of a field uses only the kept values (heatmap_values_used counts them).

filters.description: Filters array. Format: "field_operator=value", with the value as plain text and not URL encoded. Use search_api_documentation for reference.

heatmap_aggregation_field.description: Field for heatmap intensity (e.g., "estimate_list_price"). Without this, uses density.

heatmap_aggregation_invert_intensity.description: Invert intensity (true = lower values show higher intensity, good for affordability)

page.description: Page number for pagination, pins only (default: 1)

polygon.description: Polygon coordinates "lat_lng,lat_lng,lat_lng", an alternative to bbox for pins and clusters. A heatmap needs all four bbox values and is refused with a polygon alone.

price_quote.description: Return the cost of this request without billing it or returning data

name: map_endpoint
